movie.title: Whale Shark Jack
movie.overview: Sarah, 12, lives on a boat with her parents, who research whale sharks. Her only friend is a whale shark named Jack, who Sarah rescued when he was a pup. But following a tragic accident, mum and Sarah move to the coastal town of Exmouth. Desperate to return to her old life, Sarah pegs all her hopes on Jack, certain that when his migration brings him back to Exmouth, mum will take her out on the boat again. But Jack fails to return, so Sarah embarks on a risky mission to find him.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: After a tragic accident forces 12-year-old Sarah to leave her boat life, she embarks on a dangerous quest to reunite with the rescued whale shark she considers her best friend.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Twelve-year-old Sarah has spent her life on the water with her marine researcher parents and her best friend, a whale shark named Jack whom she rescued as a pup. Following a devastating family tragedy, Sarah and her mother are forced to relocate to the coastal town of Exmouth. Convinced that Jack's seasonal migration will bring him to Exmouth and reunite her family's old way of life, Sarah waits anxiously for his arrival. When Jack fails to appear, Sarah sets off on a risky, independent mission across the ocean to find him.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Sarah is a twelve-year-old girl who has grown up living on a boat alongside her scientist parents, dedicated to researching ocean life. Her closest companion is Jack, a gentle whale shark she rescued when he was just a vulnerable pup. Their unique bond forms the anchor of Sarah's life until a tragic accident shatters her family's dynamic. Forced to leave the open sea behind, Sarah and her mother move into a quiet mainland routine in the coastal town of Exmouth. Struggling to adjust to her landlocked lifestyle, Sarah clings tightly to the hope that her past isn't entirely lost. She knows Jack's natural migration path brings him toward Exmouth, and she believes his arrival will convince her mother to take her back out onto the water. As the migration season arrives, local sightings begin, but Jack is nowhere to be found. Realizing that something may have gone wrong, Sarah decides she cannot simply wait around any longer. Driven by loyalty and a deep desire to reclaim her old life, she embarks on a high-stakes, perilous mission to locate her underwater friend.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of Australia's vibrant marine life, Whale Shark Jack is an emotional family drama about grief, friendship, and resilience. Twelve-year-old Sarah has spent her life at sea with her oceanographer parents, developing an extraordinary bond with Jack, a whale shark she rescued as a pup. When an unexpected tragedy disrupts her idyllic existence, Sarah and her mother are uprooted to the coastal town of Exmouth. Struggling to adapt to life on land, Sarah places all her hopes on Jack's upcoming migration, believing his arrival will rekindle her mother's passion for the ocean. But when Jack vanishes from his usual migratory route, Sarah must brave the open waters in a courageous attempt to find him and save the bond that holds her world together.

story_structure.climax: Sarah confronts extreme danger and personal limits during her perilous search for Jack out on the open water, forced to face the harsh truths of her situation.
story_structure.conflict: A tragic accident shatters Sarah's life at sea, forcing her and her mother to move to the coastal town of Exmouth and leaving Sarah desperate to regain her former life.
story_structure.resolution: Sarah comes to terms with the emotional impact of the tragedy, navigating her grief and reaching a meaningful understanding with her mother about their future.
story_structure.introduction: Twelve-year-old Sarah lives aboard a research boat with her parents, studying marine life and forming a unique bond with Jack, a whale shark she rescued as a pup.
story_structure.risingAction: Believing that Jack's seasonal migration back to Exmouth will motivate her mother to return to boat life, Sarah waits anxiously. When Jack fails to appear, Sarah decides to embark on a risky solo mission to locate him.
